subject: Hosted API pricing & vendor onboarding — completed vendor form and PO path
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pricing and vendor forms for Acme — next steps
Attachments: vendor_quote.pdf (quote), Acme_Vendor_Form.docx (placeholder)

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. As discussed, attaching our standard pricing quote for Hosted API usage and an editable copy of your vendor form so we can move vendor onboarding along. Quick summary of the commercial options we proposed:

- Pay-as-you-go (no commit): $25.00 per million tokens (list).
- 3-month commit (minimum $50k/month): $18.00 per million tokens, monthly true-up.
- 12-month commit (minimum $150k/month): $12.00 per million tokens, minimum monthly invoice.

Example: if you average 10M tokens/month on the 12m commit, that would be ~ $120/month * 10 = $1,200 (example simplified). We provided a price schedule with intended rounding and invoicing examples in the attached price_schedule.pdf.

We typically accept a PO referencing our quote; standard invoices on Net30. If your procurement team prefers the vendor form completed instead, please send the latest version and we will fill out what we can and loop in legal for any terms that require negotiation.

Next steps:
- Please confirm which commit tier you want to lock for an initial term (3 or 12 months) or if you prefer pay-as-you-go.
- Send the completed vendor form and any specific fields your AP team requires (vendor codes, tax ID placement, remittance address).

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if that helps resolve any fields in the vendor form.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
---
Redwood Inference | https://redwoodinference.com

From: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@acme.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing and vendor forms for Acme — next steps
Attachments: Acme_Vendor_Form_Fillable.docx

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the overview. Procurement reviewed the quote and we have a few concerns before we can issue a PO:

1) Our preferred procurement process requires completion of our vendor form (attached). We need Redwood to complete and sign that form, including acceptance of Net30, our standard indemnity clause, and the vendor onboarding checklist.
2) Finance is pushing back on variable, usage-based spend for forecasting reasons — they prefer a fixed monthly charge or a fixed unit price with a guaranteed not-to-exceed amount per month and an annual PO.
3) Please provide your W-9/EIN and primary contact for vendor setup.
4) Our security team also asked for the standard SOC2 attestation and confirmation that logs are retained for 13 months (we provided the security questionnaire separately).

We can be flexible on term length, but the form needs to be completed by Redwood legal before procurement can create the PO. Can your legal and finance team fill the attached vendor form and return it by EOD Friday? If not, we will need to pause until the required paperwork is complete.

Regards,
Olivia Barnes
Senior Procurement Manager | Acme Corp
procurement@acme.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@acme.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Jul 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing and vendor forms for Acme — next steps

Olivia —

Appreciate the clear list — copying our finance and legal leads to accelerate. Quick responses to your bullets:

1) Vendor form: we can fill the administrative fields (tax id, remittance address, contacts) and return a completed copy. On standard terms (indemnity/limitation of liability/termination) we may need small amendments — particularly to preserve our standard pricing schedule as an appended exhibit so that invoicing references a price schedule rather than embedding dynamic per-token language in the body of the form. If your legal team can allow a short price schedule annex, that is our preference and keeps procurement happy while preserving commercial clarity.

2) Forecasting: we can offer a compromise — a committed monthly minimum (invoiceable) with a monthly true-up for overage at the committed tier price. Example:
   - 12-month commit: minimum $150k/month (invoiceable). Unit price: $12.00 per million tokens for committed usage. Overage billed monthly at $14.00 per million tokens.
   - 3-month commit: minimum $50k/month, committed price $18.00 per million tokens, overage $20.00 per million tokens.
   - No commit: $25.00 per million tokens.

This structure gives Finance a predictable minimum for forecasting while keeping the usage economics intact. We can expressly state the invoiceable minimum in the vendor form/PO and provide a month-by-month true-up report.

3) W-9/EIN: attached — I will send the signed W-9 and a filled copy of your vendor form once Laura confirms the legal language.

4) SOC2/log retention: Stephanie, can we confirm SOC2 attestation and log retention window (13 months) and send the standard security evidence package back to Acme?

If Acme prefers a strictly fixed monthly fee (no true-up or overage), that is a productized pricing option but requires a higher committed minimum to align economics. Happy to model that if preferred.

Karthik

From: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@acme.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com, Kevin Zhou <kevin.zhou@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2026 11:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing and vendor forms for Acme — next steps

Karthik/Team —

Thanks for the suggested compromise. A few clarifications from Finance/Security:

- Finance will accept a committed monthly minimum plus true-up only if the vendor form includes an explicit not-to-exceed provision for the monthly invoice and the committed minimum is clearly called out on the PO. They want the ability to cap monthly spend at the committed minimum without accepting surprise overages.
- We cannot accept language that requires us to engage a separate annex to determine baseline pricing post-signature — all billable unit rates need to be referenced in the vendor paperwork they sign.
- Security confirmed SOC2 Type II is required; log retention 13 months acceptable. They want confirmation that Redwood will provide evidence within 5 business days upon request.

I've attached Acme's preferred vendor form (fillable) — please return a completed version with W-9, insurance certificate (or insurance binder), and the exact price schedule you intend to be part of the PO. If Redwood can complete those items verbatim, Procurement will route an annual PO for signature.

We appreciate the flexibility — can you return the completed form and W-9 by Friday 31 Jul so we can issue a PO next week?

Olivia

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Acme procurement pushback — need sign-off to accept vendor form with price schedule annex

Team —

Acme remains motivated but procurement insists their vendor form + explicit price schedule are completed before issuing the PO. Key asks from procurement:
- Completed vendor form with fields filled (name, EIN, remittance).
- W-9 and insurance evidence.
- Price schedule inserted into the form (they refuse to accept a separate unsigned annex).
- SOC2 evidence available within 5 business days.

Options I see:
A) We populate the vendor form, copy the pricing table into the form as their "price schedule", add a short clause that redwood's pricing is as stated in the attached price_schedule.pdf and that any changes require 30 days notice. This is the fastest path to a PO but may require acceptance of procurement's templated indemnity and payment language with only minor edits.
B) Push back and require an explicit annex outside the vendor form. This will delay PO creation by 1–2 weeks while legal negotiates.
C) Offer a fixed-priced productized bundle (larger minimum) to meet Finance's request for a predictable fixed monthly fee.

Recommendation: go with A for speed to revenue. We preserve economics by inserting the full price schedule into the vendor form (copy verbatim) and add a short Redwood-approved clause limiting retroactive price changes and preserving our SLA/exclusions. Laura/Stephanie — can we get sign-off to complete the vendor form with those limited additions? Marcus — can you prepare the price_schedule.pdf with the exact line-item formatting Acme wants so we can paste it into the form?

If we agree, I'll return the completed vendor form and W-9 to Olivia Friday morning and ask for an annual PO that references the price schedule.

Thanks,
Karthik

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@acme.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Completed vendor form, W-9 and price schedule (Acme PO path)
Attachments: vendor_form_filled.pdf, W-9_Redwood.pdf, price_schedule.pdf

Hi Olivia —

Thanks for the patience. Attached are: (1) the Acme vendor form with administrative fields completed and the price schedule pasted into Section 4 as requested; (2) a signed W-9 for Redwood Inference; and (3) a line-item price_schedule.pdf formatted for insertion into the PO.

Quick summary of the commercial terms we included in the pasted price schedule:
- 12-month committed option (invoiceable minimum $150,000/month) — committed unit rate $12.00 per million tokens; overage 14.00 per million tokens billed monthly.
- 3-month committed option (invoiceable minimum $50,000/month) — committed unit rate $18.00 per million tokens; overage 20.00 per million tokens billed monthly.
- Pay-as-you-go option — $25.00 per million tokens.

We added one limited, Redwood-approved clause into Section 9: "Price adjustments will not be applied retroactively to invoiced periods and Redwood will provide 30 days' notice for any unit price changes affecting future invoices." We kept indemnity and standard payment terms as in your form.

Per your request, Redwood's SOC2 Type II report and evidence bundle will be available on request within 3 business days — Stephanie is copied and will coordinate delivery.

Please confirm the PO number and remit-to details when the PO is issued. We will begin provisioning as soon as the PO is received and the initial invoice (first month minimum) is issued.

Appreciate the partnership — happy to jump on a quick call if you want to walk the form.

Best,
Karthik
Attachments: vendor_form_filled.pdf, W-9_Redwood.pdf, price_schedule.pdf
